pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with rounded vertices. Gradients between dark patches and light corridors are distinct but exhibit moderate pixel-level blurring at this resolution. Patches on the lower neck are larger in relative spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned pathways form a continuous lattice of negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent and quadrivalent. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the midsection, with high topological continuity maintained across the visible flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude serration against the blurred background. Individual hair clusters create a repetitive, jagged 1D silhouette with high frequency from the mid-neck to the shoulder transition.
